title: Dev and start scripts require undeclared global CLIs

evidence.quote: "dev": "bgproc start -n visitenkarte -f -w -- env PORTLESS_PORT=443 portless visitenkarte astro dev"
`bun run dev` (or `bun run start`): run local Astro dev server.

reasoning: The documented local workflow tells contributors to run `bun run dev` or `bun run start`, but the script shells out to `bgproc` and `portless` while the package manifest only installs Astro, Tailwind, Playwright, and related project dependencies. A fresh checkout that follows `bun install` can fail before Astro starts unless those user-specific CLIs already exist on PATH.
reproduction: On an environment without global `bgproc` and `portless`, run `bun install` followed by `bun run dev`; command lookup fails before the Astro dev server starts.
recommendation: Either declare the required CLIs as dev dependencies or change the standard dev script to use declared tools only. If global `bgproc`/`portless` are intentional, document their installation as a prerequisite and provide a fallback script such as plain `astro dev`.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The linked visual tests run `bun run build` and Playwright against `astro preview`; they do not exercise the `dev` or `start` package scripts on a clean install.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a lightweight CI smoke check that validates all first-token package script commands resolve from declared dependencies or an explicit allowlist.
minimumFixScope: Update `package.json` dev/start scripts and the local workflow documentation.

history.reasoning: Original package.json evidence still exists: scripts.dev uses bgproc and portless at line 6, and scripts.start delegates to bun dev at line 7. The dependency block moved to package.json lines 21-46 and still does not declare bgproc or portless; node_modules/.bin only contains declared CLIs such as astro/playwright for this check. AGENTS.md evidence changed: lines 19-23 now document bgproc/portless and add a dev:plain fallback, which mitigates contributor guidance, but the standard dev/start scripts still fail without the undeclared globals. A focused smoke check with PATH limited to local node_modules/.bin, node, and system bins reproduced /bin/bash: bgproc: command not found for bun run dev, while bun run dev:plain -- --help succeeded under the same PATH.

find node_modules/.bin -maxdepth 1 -type l -o -type f 2>/dev/null | sed 's#^node_modules/.bin/##' | sort | rg '^(bgproc|portless|astro|playwright)$'
command -v bgproc; command -v portless; command -v astro; command -v playwright
rg -n '"(bgproc|portless)"|bgproc@|portless@|name = "(bgproc|portless)"' bun.lock package-lock.json pnpm-lock.yaml yarn.lock deno.lock 2>/dev/null

Focused smoke checks with PATH excluding the directory containing bgproc/portless showed bun run dev -- --help resolves to astro dev, and bun run start -- --help also resolves to astro dev when Bun itself is available; bun run dev:portless still fails without bgproc, but that is now an optional documented script rather than the standard workflow. bun run check passed with only existing hints.
